urls.rationale: Article 1 - General Provisions: definitions (officer, lobbyist, prohibited source) used throughout the Ethics Act.
Article 5 - Ethical Conduct: includes revolving-door restrictions on officials/employees becoming registered lobbyists, directly tied to the lobbying-disclosure regime.
Article 10 - Gift Ban: restricts gifts from prohibited sources including registered lobbyists; integral to the lobbying-disclosure compliance regime.
Article 50 - Penalties: enforcement and penalties cross-referenced from the lobbying / gift-ban / revolving-door provisions.

notes: Inspector-general / commission structural articles (15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 70, 75) intentionally excluded as not directly lobbying-disclosure. Amendatory (90) and miscellaneous (99) provisions excluded.
